origin.summary: Workout 2 of the 2021 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: The same ascending dumbbell snatch ladder with burpee box jump-overs as 17.1, reused four years later.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2021/2 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
